source.book: 山海經·東山經·東次四經
source.text: 有鳥焉，其狀如雞而白首，鼠足而虎爪，其名曰鬿雀，亦食人。

inferred.item: 原生鸡形颈胸、双翼与短扇尾
inferred.basis: 据「其狀如雞」采用鸡的原生颈、胸骨、骨盆、羽翼与尾羽体积；具体比例、尾形、向侧方略转的头部姿态为设计补足。
经文未记鸡冠与肉垂；保留鸡形参考中的小冠、面颊及喉部肉垂，统一作白首设色，属可选的鸡形艺术解剖，不主张经文明确记有这些部件。

inferred.item: 霜白头羽、赭褐背翼与金褐短喙
inferred.basis: 白首直接据「白首」；白羽边界、赭褐羽色、深色眼与金褐喙均为艺术设色。短喙沿原生鸡首的朝向延展并减轻末端钩曲。

inferred.item: 双足鼠样踝掌，每足五根细长不等趾
inferred.basis: 据「鼠足」参考鼠类后足的踝部、渐宽足背与细长分趾；连续皮肤、肌腱起伏、细皮褶和五趾的不等长与分向均为视觉补足。经文未记足数、趾数、裸皮颜色或足底形态。

inferred.item: 趾末鞘中生出的长弯爪
inferred.basis: 据「虎爪」作粗根渐尖、向前延伸后下弯的角质爪；爪长、弧度、金褐色与外露状态为设计推断。

inferred.item: 缓步、展翼侧倾抬足示爪与短促粗鸣
inferred.basis: 原文记「亦食人」，未详动作和鸣声；直线缓步、展翼时向支撑足侧移重心、抬另一足示爪以及合成鸣声均为交互演绎。

sourceVerification.matchingMethod: Exact continuous quote in the unmodified cached raw wikitext, independently inspected offline; no new network fetch. Context SHA covers the complete 北號之山 paragraph, including its two leading ideographic spaces and excluding newline.
sourceVerification.note: 東次四經北號之山条，临于北海。仅引连续的完整鸟条，不将山名与隔开的鸟条拼作连续引文；鸡形、白首、鼠足、虎爪、食人均见正文。

bodySource.provenanceLimit: Actual cached runtime bytes and decoded primitive counts verified. Original HIGH masters were unavailable in this worktree; their upstream receipts are not presented as newly reopened or independently reverified originals.

sculpt.status: parent structural preview accepted; runtime acceptance separate

production.adaptation: Offline native chicken donor tissue retains neck, breast, pelvis, native tail and paired wing volume. White head/brown coat are repainted in the donor UVs; native oblique bill is extended and its hook reduced with guarded inverse-transpose authored normals. Scaly lower legs removed. New continuous remeshed skin surfaces join calf/ankle/instep/tendons to ten staggered thin digits; ten long swept keratin claws emerge at matching distal sheaths without knob roots. No new paid generation or TTS, no source feather simplification. Rigging only translates the accepted sculpt down 3mm to its original lowest sole level; no foot flattening during rigging.
production.locomotion: 18 bones; idle 4s, straight 0.10m/s walk 1.6s with 65% stance, alert 4.2s. Folded relaxed wings at rest. Left foot rises while pelvis shifts toward the planted right foot. Private world-space two-bone contacts preserve complete rigid foot anchors through blended transitions.

runtime.clawOwnership: Each complete connected claw is rigidly assigned to its own foot, including the inner tip crossing the centreline; two continuous skin surfaces retain only their same-side leg/foot influences.

support.coverage: Independent authored masks include idle, walk phase zero/startup/full stance and endpoints, all six action switches pre/effect/dt0 and first 200ms, special full right support plus initial/final left stance through 4.2s.

qa.audio: Existing narration decoded and actually played; stop pauses, resets time to zero and detaches. Procedural call/footstep RMS positive; canceled special timer produces zero calls; special returns to idle and all three buttons work.
qa.captures: /tmp/qique-remake/final-v2-qa/{idle,walk,special}-*.png; required shot.mjs final-v2-{idle,walk,special}.png and closeups.mjs final-v2-motion{0,1,2}.png

rejectedRuntime.reason: Numerical contacts passed but raised-foot closeups revealed a claw split between feet. Rejected visually and replaced with whole-component weighting.
